value.rationale: The Fano matroid is the canonical rank-three binary geometry, and the quotient by oriented collinear triangles is its natural minimal modification of a simplex skeleton. A sharp factor-four obstruction to integral symmetry splitting is a structural fact invisible to shellability, ordinary Betti ranks, or rational representation theory. The explicit 13=7+3+3bar decomposition complements the integral obstruction and identifies the rational constituents used in equivariant topology.
